content: iOS Safari refuses canvases whose width*height exceeds 16,777,216 px with 'Canvas area exceeds the maximum limit'. A 1600px-longest-edge destination canvas is ~2M px so it is never the constraint; the constraint is the decoded source bitmap of a 48MP phone photo (~192MB). Symptom of exceeding it is a black/blank output rather than a thrown error, so a null-or-tiny toBlob result must be treated as failure.
